titleEn: What was the original first-person shooter? Two largely forgotten computer games from the 1970s ushered in the genre
titleZh: 最早的第一人称射击游戏是什么？两款被遗忘的七十年代游戏
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Curious Kids is a series for children of all ages. If you have a question you’d like an expert to answer, send it to CuriousKidsUS@theconversation.com.
paragraphs.zh: 《好奇的孩子》是一个适合所有年龄段儿童的系列节目。如果您有问题希望专家解答，请发送至CuriousKidsUS@theconversation.com。

paragraphs.en:
What was the first “first-person shooter” video game?
– James, age 12, Batesville, Arkansas
paragraphs.zh:
第一个“第一人称射击游戏”是什么？
- 詹姆斯，12岁，来自阿肯色州贝茨维尔

paragraphs.en: Before “Call of Duty,” before “Counter-Strike” and before “Doom,” there was “Maze War.”
paragraphs.zh: 在《使命召唤》、《反恐精英》和《毁灭战士》之前，有《迷宫战争》。

paragraphs.en: Generally considered the earliest first-person shooter game, or FPS, “Maze War” was developed at a NASA research center beginning in 1973. A year later, another FPS, “Spasim,” debuted. It was developed at the University of Illinois.
paragraphs.zh: 通常被认为是最早的第一人称射击游戏，或FPS，“迷宫战争”是在美国宇航局的研究中心于1973年开始开发的。一年后，另一个FPS，“Spasim”，首次亮相。它是在伊利诺伊大学开发的。

paragraphs.en: In first-person shooters, players experience the game through the eyes of a character, using a gun or other weapon to attack enemies. To pull off this first-person perspective, developers needed to create a 3D world for the players to move through – no easy feat in the early 1970s.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一人称射击游戏中，玩家通过角色的眼睛体验游戏，使用枪或其他武器攻击敌人。为了实现这种第一人称视角，开发人员需要为玩家创建一个3D世界-在20世纪70年代早期并不容易。

paragraphs.en: At the time, the computer hardware behind the most popular arcade game, “PONG,” and the first home video game system, the Magnavox Odyssey, wasn’t powerful enough to render the kind of 3D depth that allowed players to move forward into a virtual space, with objects appearing in the distance.
paragraphs.zh: 当时，最受欢迎的街机游戏“PONG”和第一个家庭视频游戏系统Magnavox Odyssey背后的计算机硬件还不够强大，无法呈现3D深度，让玩家进入虚拟空间，物体出现在远处。

paragraphs.en: That’s why both games were developed on systems that had more processing power and speed. “Maze War” first appeared on an Imlac PDS-1 minicomputer, while “Spasim” – short for “space simulator” – launched on PLATO, an early networked computer system.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是为什么这两款游戏都是在处理能力和速度更强的系统上开发的。“迷宫战争”最初出现在一台Imlac PDS-1小型计算机上，而“Spasim”--“太空模拟器”的简称--则是在早期的联网计算机系统PLATO上推出的。

paragraphs.en: Since everyday people couldn’t easily access the Imlac PDS-1 minicomputer or PLATO, these two games have been largely forgotten. But they paved the way for one of today’s most popular video game genres.
paragraphs.zh: 由于普通人无法轻易使用Imlac PDS-1小型计算机或PLATO，这两款游戏在很大程度上被遗忘了。但它们为当今最流行的视频游戏类型之一铺平了道路。

paragraphs.en: Out of sight, but not out of mind
paragraphs.zh: 眼不见心不烦

paragraphs.en: Both games allowed players to move through a 3D space and shoot enemy figures that appeared onscreen in the player’s view.
paragraphs.zh: 这两款游戏都允许玩家在3D空间中移动，并射击在玩家视野中出现的敌人。

paragraphs.en: In “Spasim,” movement and shooting didn’t occur in real time. You moved by jumping from one position to another, with a short lag time needed to render the next view.
paragraphs.zh: 在“Spasim”中，移动和射击并不是在真实的时间内发生的，你通过从一个位置跳到另一个位置来移动，需要很短的延迟时间来渲染下一个视图。

paragraphs.en: In “Maze War,” players could move relatively smoothly in a straight line down hallways. Turning, however, needed to be done in 90-degree increments, which created some potentially confusing graphics as entire scenes abruptly appeared. In the single-player mode, danger could lurk just around the corner: Robots would automatically shoot you if they were in line with you down a hallway.
paragraphs.zh: 在《迷宫战争》中，玩家可以相对平稳地沿着走廊直线移动。然而，转弯需要以90度的增量进行，当整个场景突然出现时，这可能会产生一些令人困惑的画面。在单人模式下，危险可能就在拐角处：如果机器人和你一起沿着走廊排成一行，它们会自动向你开枪。

paragraphs.en: “Maze War” and “Spasim” also had multiplayer modes that allowed networked players to shoot at each other. Before video games, popular shooting games – the kind found at fairs and carnivals – generally involved friendly competition, with players competing to see who could hit targets most accurately. The kill-or-be-killed death matches of “Maze War” and “Spasim” completely upended the way guns were used in play and competition.
paragraphs.zh: “迷宫战争”和“Spasim”也有多人模式，允许联网的玩家互相射击。在视频游戏之前，流行的射击游戏--集市和嘉年华上的那种--通常涉及友好竞争，玩家们互相竞争看谁能最准确地击中目标。“迷宫战争”和“斯帕西姆”的死亡竞赛彻底颠覆了枪支在比赛中的使用方式

paragraphs.en: ‘Maze War’ introduced another new twist: the possibility of getting shot at and killed from behind, without ever seeing your attacker. Instead of the fixed and unchanging point of view found in a shooting gallery, ‘Maze War’ required you to constantly look around to try to keep track of everything in your immediate area.
paragraphs.zh: 《迷宫战争》引入了另一个新的转折：你可能会在看不到袭击者的情况下从背后被射杀。《迷宫战争》要求你不断环顾四周，试图跟踪你附近的一切，而不是像射击场那样固定不变的视角。

paragraphs.en: And unlike most video games up to this point, players didn’t see the entirety of a game’s world from a godlike perspective. Instead, there was a sense of offscreen space surrounding the player, with events occurring out of the player’s sight.
paragraphs.zh: 而且和目前大多数游戏不同的是，玩家并不是从神的视角去看游戏世界的全部，而是有一种画面外的空间感，在玩家的视线之外发生的事情。

paragraphs.en: Building a 3D world with lines
paragraphs.zh: 用线条构建3D世界

paragraphs.en: Both ‘Maze War’ and ‘Spasim’ used what are called vector graphics, which are images made by drawing lines directly between points on the screen.
paragraphs.zh: 《迷宫战争》和《Spasim》都使用了所谓的矢量图形，即通过在屏幕上的点之间直接画线来制作图像。

paragraphs.en: Compared with the other popular form of computer graphics, known as raster graphics, vector graphics were particularly well suited for creating a first-person perspective. They contain clean lines that converge at a vanishing point, making a flat screen appear to stretch into the distance. Raster graphics, on the other hand, create pictures by filling in a grid of tiny pixels, an approach that was less suited to drawing the crisp lines needed to create this kind of perspective.
paragraphs.zh: 与另一种流行的计算机图形形式--光栅图形相比，矢量图形特别适合创建第一人称视角。矢量图形包含在消失点处会聚的清晰线条，使平面屏幕看起来延伸到远处。另一方面，光栅图形通过填充微小像素的网格来创建图片，这种方法不太适合绘制这种透视所需的清晰线条。

paragraphs.en: By 1977, video game fans could play Cinematronic’s “Space Wars,” which used vector graphics, at arcades. In 1978, Vectorbeam’s “Speed Freak” deployed vector graphics to render the first real-time, 3D computer animation in an arcade video game – an explosion of car parts when the player crashed. Atari’s 1980 arcade game “Battlezone” was a huge hit that gave many players their first chance to try a first-person shooting game.
paragraphs.zh: 到1977年，视频游戏迷们可以在拱廊上玩Cinematronic的“太空战争”，它使用了矢量图形。1978年，Vectorbeam的“速度怪胎”部署了矢量图形来渲染第一个实时，3D电脑动画在一个街机视频游戏-汽车零件爆炸时，球员坠毁。雅达利的1980街机游戏“战地”是一个巨大的打击，让许多玩家第一次有机会尝试第一人称射击游戏。

paragraphs.en: “Maze War” and “Spasim” didn’t have the aiming capabilities that players are used to today. Shooting was done with a keystroke, with aiming limited to facing in the right direction. Nor did they have the speed, spectacle and realism of their modern descendants. But they introduced something more fundamental: a new way of seeing and experiencing a video game.
paragraphs.zh: “迷宫战争”和“Spasim”并没有玩家们如今已经习惯的瞄准功能。射击是用一个瞄准器完成的，瞄准仅限于面向正确的方向。它们也没有现代后代的速度、壮观和真实感。但它们引入了一些更基本的东西：一种观看和体验电子游戏的新方式。
